name: cursor-chinese
description: cursor chinese — Cursor 编辑器一键汉化工具

scripts.build: npm run build:win && npm run build:mac && npm run build:linux
scripts.build:mac: pkg . --output dist/cursor-chinese-macos-x64 --targets node18-macos-x64 --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" && pkg . --output dist/cursor-chinese-macos-arm64 --targets node18-macos-arm64 --no-bytecode --public-packages "*"
scripts.build:linux: pkg . --output dist/cursor-chinese-linux-x64 --targets node18-linux-x64 --no-bytecode --public-packages "*" && pkg . --output dist/cursor-chinese-linux-arm64 --targets node18-linux-arm64 --no-bytecode --public-packages "*"
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run pack:release
